20261122-physics-e4-1.title: Echiche ọzọ
20261122-physics-e4-1.goal: Tinye ụkpụrụ nke Echiche ọzọ iji dozie nsogbu nnyocha.
20261122-physics-e4-1.material: [Echiche ọzọ] Mgbe a na-eji lever buli nnukwu nkume ma tinye ebe mkpọchi nso nkume (ebe ọrụ), ike e ji akpụ aka na-ebelata. Kedu ka ụzọ aka ga-agafe si agbanwe?
20261122-physics-e4-1.s.s1.prompt: [Echiche ọzọ] Mgbe a na-eji lever buli nnukwu nkume ma tinye ebe mkpọchi nso nkume (ebe ọrụ), ike e ji akpụ aka na-ebelata. Kedu ka ụzọ aka ga-agafe si agbanwe?
